post.summary: Cancel a PENDING or APPROVED booking by mode
post.description: Modes: `CUSTOMER`, `SALON`, `ADMIN`. CUSTOMER = as if the customer cancelled (refund by the snapshotted policy; everything while PENDING), SALON = the salon cancels (full refund), ADMIN = platform decision (full refund; recorded as a salon-side cancellation because no separate status exists, the history keeps the admin as the actor). 422 `INVALID_TRANSITION` for other statuses (use the status endpoint). Needs a reason, is audited; refunds start through the refund engine and the parties are notified.

post.summary: Refund a chosen amount of the online payment
post.description: `amount` is a JOD string above zero and at most what is still refundable (400 `body.amount`). 422 `INVALID_TRANSITION` when nothing was paid online. The refund starts at once and retries like any refund; while payments are paused nothing can have been paid, so it answers 422. Needs a reason, is audited.
